about: A practice system's printed lab sheet (x.isynet Laborblatt), photographed, as the phone's recogniser returned it: table cells and text fragments with the real page's geometry, misread units and misaligned rows. Every result value is invented; units and published reference ranges are kept; names, dates, IDs, practice and laboratory are invented. Coordinates are normalised, y counts up from the bottom.
